data.investment_objective: The objective of the Scheme is to seek to provide investment returns that, before expenses, closely track the performance of domestic prices of Gold derived from the LBMA AM fixing prices. However, the performance of the Scheme may differ from that of the underlying gold due to tracking error. There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme is not actively managed. The Scheme may also participate in Exchange Traded Commodity Derivatives (ETCDs) with gold as underlying.
data.asset_allocation:
• Gold bullion and instruments with Gold as underlying  that  may be specified by SEBI = 95%-100%
• Debt & Money Market Instruments including units of Debt oriented Mutual Funds* =  0%-5%
data.benchmark: LBMA AM Fixing Prices (Domestic Prices of Gold)
